content:
customer_ops (AcmeCorp): Hey team — after our IdP cert rotation this morning, SSO logins started failing for our users. They get a 403 at the ACS step. We re-uploaded metadata but no change.

support_agent_julie: Sorry about that — can you paste the SP ACS URL and the SP entityID that your IdP is sending in the assertion? Also any error logs you see.

customer_ops (AcmeCorp): ACS: https://app.acme.com/sso/acs
SP EntityID: https://app.acme.com/
Error from our proxy: 403 Recipient mismatch. IdP audit shows assertion destination=https://scim.redwood.ai/sso/acs (weird).

support_agent_julie: Hmm ok. That destination being the scim host is unexpected. Do you use tenant routing / subdomains? Any proxies in front of the SP that could rewrite the destination?

customer_ops (AcmeCorp): We use tenant subdomains (acme.app). RelayState is /t/acme/dashboard. We noticed after cert rotation the IdP metadata still contains an old ACS entry pointing at https://account.redwood.ai/sso/acs. Could it be picking the wrong ACS index when building the response?

support_agent_julie: Can you fetch your metadata and paste the AssertionConsumerService entries? Also please include the SAMLResponse (base64 header) if you can — we can decode the destination. Quick command to fetch metadata: `curl -sS https://idp.acme.com/metadata.xml | xmllint --format -`

customer_ops (AcmeCorp): Ran that — metadata includes two ACS entries: index 0 -> https://account.redwood.ai/sso/acs (old), index 1 -> https://app.acme.com/sso/acs (current). We rotated certs yesterday and updated keys, but I think we left the old ACS in place. IdP logs show it chose index 0 for signed response.

customer_ops (AcmeCorp): Full IdP error snippet (redacted):
```
2024-11-02T02:14:01Z ERROR SAML: Assertion rejected - recipient mismatch
Expected recipient: https://app.acme.com/sso/acs
Actual destination: https://account.redwood.ai/sso/acs
RelayState: /t/acme/dashboard
Signature validated against cert thumbprint: 3A:4B:...
```

eng_sso_miguel: Paging eng-sso group — looks like the IdP is picking the wrong ACS index. We recently changed the metadata poller behavior; possible ordering issue on parse after rotation. I'll reproduce locally with the given metadata.

eng_infra_rita: @eng_sso_miguel FYI there was a metadata-cache TTL tweak in infra deploy yesterday morning (2024-11-02T01:50Z). Logs: `metadata-watcher` reparse at 2024-11-02T02:12:34Z for idp.acme.com. Could have picked up ordering from the XML canonicalization change.

support_agent_julie: Short-term mitigation options for the customer: 1) Ask IdP admin to remove the obsolete ACS entry (recommended). 2) Reorder metadata so the correct ACS is first. 3) Temporarily configure IdP to target the explicit ACS via index or binding. Can you remove index 0 until we fix the backend behavior?

eng_sso_miguel: I'll open an internal ticket to add a tolerant fallback: match destination host->tenant mapping if exact ACS doesn't match. But that's a code change and needs review. For immediate relief, removing the old ACS entry from metadata should fix it.

support_lead_dev: Marking this P1 for Dedicated/Demo customers. @eng_sso_miguel please include risk/rollback plan.

oncall_bot: Incident INC-2024-8725 created and assigned to eng_sso_miguel. Priority: P1.

customer_ops (AcmeCorp): We can remove the old ACS entry now. We'll confirm after IdP metadata republish. Please keep us posted, and thanks for the suggested workaround.

support_agent_julie: Thanks — keep this thread updated once you republish metadata. We'll monitor for failed logins and flag regression if needed. Closing when we confirm successful login for a few users. :thumbsup:
